title: Noise sensitivity and its curve
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{ -1,1\}$, and let $0\le\delta\le1$. The noise sensitivity curve of the real-valued version of $f$ at $\delta$ equals the noise sensitivity of $f$ at $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
